lesson: Hormozi 2027 strategy video, numbered process with one action per slide (Use for us #2 and #5)

slides.eyebrow: Here's what actually happens if you skip
slides.sub: Skip one and you can lose the offer, miss problems in the house, or sign numbers you never checked.

slides.title: 1. No preapproval?
slides.body: Sellers often require a preapproval letter before they'll accept your offer. Getting one early also helps you [[spot issues in time]] to fix them.

slides.title: 2. No inspection?
slides.body: An appraisal is [[not a home inspection]]. FHA doesn't guarantee a home's value or condition. An inspection tells you about the house before you commit.

slides.title: 3. No Closing Disclosure check?
slides.body: Your lender has to give it to you at least 3 business days before closing. Use those 3 days to [[compare it to your Loan Estimate]]. Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.
slides.source: CFPB, What is a Closing Disclosure? (Oct. 2026)

slides.title: 4. No final walk-through?
slides.body: Before you sign anything, walk the home one last time. Make sure the [[repairs you agreed on]] got done. If not, speak up before closing.

caption:
Here's what actually happens if you skip these 4 steps when buying a home in NJ.

1. No preapproval? Sellers often require a preapproval letter before they'll accept your offer.
2. No inspection? An appraisal is not a home inspection, and FHA doesn't guarantee a home's value or condition.
3. No Closing Disclosure check? Your lender has to give it to you at least 3 business days before closing so you can compare it to your Loan Estimate.
4. No final walk-through? You won't know if the agreed repairs got done before you sign.

Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.
